info.title: DurianOS API
info.description:
Offline-first household data sync.

**Dev sign-in (APP_ENV=dev):** call `POST /v1/auth/session` with provider `google` and id_token `dev:demo` (the seeded household), copy the `token`, click *Authorize* and paste it. `dev:<anything>` creates a fresh empty household.

post.description:
Swap a Google / Apple `id_token` for a session token.

Dev only (`APP_ENV=dev`): `dev:<subject>[:<name>]` is accepted as the token; the seeded
demo household is `dev:demo`.
Revoke the calling session (addition to the contract).

Username + password sign-in for admin accounts (addition to the contract).

Returns the same `{token, user}` as `/v1/auth/session`; admin routes still require an
`admin_members` row.

delete.description:
Revoke every session and erase the user's rows in one transaction. Photo bytes are
removed afterwards from a `deletion_jobs` entry; `media_pending` counts them.
